title: Winning War With Iran Requires Patience, Says Retired Army Brigadier General
title_cn: 退役陆军准将表示，赢得与伊朗的战争需要耐心

Kimmitt also cast doubt on the idea that the US could win the war with an air campaign alone as the Trump administration moves to put economic rather than military pressure on Iran.  (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: Get a jump start on the US trading day with Dave Gura on "Bloomberg Open Interest." Signs the consumer is finally slowing sown. Today, retail sales post their biggest drop in more than a year as confidence slides. Oil rises as Washington threatens more economic pressure on Iran. Plus, OpenAI’s revenue surge ahead of a highly anticipated IPO. And we’ll hear from Flock Safety CEO Garrett Langley and LOVB Pro Commissioner Sandra Idehen on the $20 million boom in women’s volleyball. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: OpenAI’s Explosive Growth Continues | Bloomberg Tech 8/14/2026
title_cn: OpenAI 持续爆炸式增长 |彭博科技 2026 年 8 月 14 日

Plus, how a New York City bill backed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani could force Amazon to directly employ its delivery workers, and Meta's former chief AI scientist joins a new venture firm to invest in early AI startups. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Beyond Chatbots: The Next Wave of AI
title_cn: 超越聊天机器人：人工智能的下一波浪潮

The trio plans to make seed-stage bets and launches with more than $100 million in assets under management. 224 Ventures General Partner Shaun Johnson discusses why the most compelling opportunities may be “nonconsensus” bets, with white space emerging in the future of work, robotics and infrastructure. He joins Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: OpenAI on Track to Double Revenue Ahead of IPO
title_cn: OpenAI 有望在 IPO 前实现收入翻倍
summary: OpenAI is on track to generate more than $40 billion in annualized revenue, roughly double its run rate at the end of 2025, according to sources. Bloomberg’s Rachel Metz explains how growth in paying ChatGPT users, enterprise adoption and coding assistant Codex are driving the surge, and why the enormous cost of computing power remains a key challenge for the AI company. She joins Tim Stenovec on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

(Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Retail Sales Fall Most Since May 2025
title_cn: 美国零售额创 2025 年 5 月以来最大降幅
summary:
US retail sales fell in July by the most in more than a year as consumers pulled back on purchases at online stores and auto dealers.
The value of retail purchases, which isn’t adjusted for inflation, decreased 0.6%, the most since May 2025, according to data published Friday by the Census Bureau.
Veronica Clark, US Economist with Citi, reacts to the US retail sales data and discusses the weakening labor market and slowing inflation. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Reddit Climbs, Applied Materials, Gemini Fall | Stock Movers
title_cn: Reddit 攀登、Applied Materials、Gemini Fall |库存搬运工
summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

Drone companies including AeroVironment Inc. (AVAV), Aevex Corp. (AVEX), and Unusual Machines Inc. (UMAC) rose on news that the Trump administration plans to apply a 100% tariff on imports of unmanned aircraft systems and their components.

Applied Matierals (AMAT) fell despite an earnings forecast that topped estimates. Investors had a muted reaction to earnings even though the stock has more than doubled this year. 

Gemini Space Station (GEMI) fell as the crypto platform's earnings report faced crypto market headwinds and a wider-than-expected adjusted Ebitda loss. 

Reddit (RDDT) climbed on the news that the stock is set to be included in the S&P 500 index. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Retail Sales Drop More Than Expected in July

summary: US retail sales fell in July by the most in more than a year as consumers pulled back on purchases at online stores and auto dealers. Sales dropped by 0.6%, the forecast was for a 0.1% gain. Bloomberg's Michael McKee has the numbers followed by Aditya Bhave from BofA Securities with reaction.  (Source: Bloomberg)

summary: A tanker ordered by Madagascar’s state power utility made way for a vessel contracted by a private group at a berth in the port of Toamasina, easing a dispute over oil-product imports.

title: Dutch PM Urges Farmers to End Highway Protests After Deaths
title_cn: 荷兰总理敦促农民结束死亡后的高速公路抗议活动
summary: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten implored farmers to keep their tractors off national highways after protests against environmental measures snarled traffic, causing accidents that claimed two lives.
